achievements.name: First Climb
achievements.detail: Reach the exit of the opening nightmare before the falling tower catches you.

achievements.name: Stray Sheep
achievements.detail: Spend an evening in the Stray Sheep and talk with one of the regulars.

achievements.name: Sheep Lesson
achievements.detail: Learn a climbing technique from a sheep on a landing between stages.

achievements.name: Confessional
achievements.detail: Give an answer in the confessional during a nightmare.

achievements.name: Text Reply
achievements.detail: Read a message on Vincent's phone and send a reply.

achievements.name: Super Rapunzel
achievements.detail: Clear a puzzle on the Super Rapunzel cabinet in the Stray Sheep.

achievements.name: Hard Stage
achievements.detail: Finish a nightmare stage with the difficulty set to Hard.

achievements.name: Night Boss
achievements.detail: Survive the chase at the end of a night and wake from the nightmare.

achievements.name: Babel
achievements.detail: Clear a Babel stage, where a single fall ends the climb and moves cannot be undone.

achievements.name: Rin's Route
achievements.detail: Steer the story onto the route Full Body adds for Rin.

achievements.name: Any Ending
achievements.detail: Reach the credits through one of the story's endings.

achievements.name: Every Ending
achievements.detail: See every ending the story can reach.
